identity.name: Submariner Date
identity.one_liner: The current-generation Submariner Date: 41mm case, caliber 3235, introduced 2020.

provenance_events.description: The 126610LN replaces the 116610LN, growing the case to 41mm while keeping the date complication. Caliber 3235. The transition is the most-cited 2020s Rolex sports-watch change.

Rolex grows the Submariner Date from 40mm to 41mm in the 126610LN release — the most-cited 2020s Rolex sports-watch change. Hong Kong collectors form a queue outside the brand's TST boutique on launch day; the secondary market runs at MSRP-plus through 2021.

narrative.story: The 2020 Submariner refresh moved the case from 40 to 41mm while slimming the lugs, retreating from the slab-sided 'Super Case' of the 116610 generation. The 3235 brought the Chronergy escapement and a 70-hour reserve. It stays one of the hardest steel-sports allocations at retail, though grey-market premiums have thinned since the 2022 peak.
narrative.collector_notes: The spread between retail and grey narrowed after 2022, so condition and full-set status decide most of the price now. Check the warranty-card date against serial-era expectations.
